summary: KANZHUN LIMITED filed a Form 6-K, its US equivalent of a current report, attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return (Form FF305) dated October 2, 2026. The filing reports routine share-count movements: 290 Class A ordinary shares issued on September 24, 2026 upon vesting of restricted share units to a non-director participant, and 271,930 shares repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled as of September 30, 2026 at USD 7.3548 per share. Closing issued shares stand at 829,269,523. The filing also corrects prior RSU settlement figures. The buyback is ordinary on-market repurchase activity rather than a tender offer.
